messages.text: Do you need the big bowl back from Mom's before your couch crowd shows up Friday?
Yes please. I already bought popcorn and Kayla said the living room can handle six if we move the coffee table.
Six people and your speaker at full blast, got it. Neighbors are gonna know every chorus.
Only during the credits. Bring the bowl and you can vote on the second pick.
Mom said you sounded wound up after clinic. You good or should I send a dumb video?
Send the dumb video. Then I am driving over to Kayla's aunt's bar to do one huge loud number and reset.
Water bottle and dramatic chorus, got it. Please don't make the microphone face again.
No promises. Jenna already picked the ridiculous duet.
Batting cage is at 6:30. You still bringing the extra glove for Tessa?
Yep, and I grabbed the signup sheet from the clinic break room so two of the girls can cover Saturday if I end up at the church kitchen.
You are always fixing the loose ends. Karaoke after, or are you saving your voice?
One song if everyone eats first. I promised Kayla I would not come home wired and hungry again.
If you take the river road home, slow down past the Miller place. Tractor is half on the shoulder.
Thanks. I was going that way anyway. I like coming in past the fields instead of the highway.
Your mom said stop by if you want leftovers. Porch light will be on.
I might. Mrs. B waved me down by the church yesterday just to ask if my tire was low.
County paper says the meeting Thursday has that clinic van item and the welding class money on the list.
Can you save it for me? I saw a Facebook post about it but it was all caps and no link.
I'll leave the paper on the table. Don't waste time reading comments.
Yep. I just want to see what they actually put in writing before I decide anything.
Mrs. B asked after you when we were cleaning up in the fellowship hall. She still remembers telling you about that opening at Dr. Larkin's.
Tell her I still think about that. I only went because I needed hours, then I blinked and knew how to set up Room 2 without asking.
That sounds like you. Start practical, then make it yours.
Did the apartment office get both signatures, or do you still need me to print that page at work?
I'm staying here for now, but I don't want to coast. I put the radiography packet on my table so I have to look at it.
They got mine. Kayla signs after her shift tomorrow, then we are set through next February.
Good. And about that dinner Friday, just enjoy it. You do not have to rearrange your whole life over one nice meal.
Exactly. I am going, but my dresser is not making room for anybody's socks.
Can I call for ten? Front desk stacked three late rooms and then I had to reopen a note from this afternoon.
Call me. Start with what has to be fixed tonight and what can wait until morning.
It is corrected now. Dana stayed while I checked the entry twice, but I still feel wound up.
Then come down from it. Eat something, write tomorrow's steps on paper, and do one thing at a time.
Can I call for ten? My notebook is a mess and I keep replaying that chart note like I let everyone down.
Call me. Put one clean page in front of you first: tomorrow, money, clinic. We will only sort those three.
I already shut TikTok off and put soup on. If I can get the list done, I think I can sleep.
Good. And you are not fixing the whole week tonight. Call me before you climb into bed.
Did you see that bridge post? Mom said people are already arguing about whether it is actually closed.
I saw it on FB while looking at the Calhoun page. I am checking the county site before I drive that way.
Smart. Send me the real one if you find it, not Aunt Linda's dramatic version.
County says one lane only after 6. Also you owe me for making me read 47 comments.
Aunt Rita dropped another long post in the family thread. You seeing that mess?
Yeah, I am not using a forwarded screenshot as my source. I saved the county page and will ask the pharmacist tomorrow.
Good. Mom already said you would have the boring official answer.
Boring is fine if it comes from somebody who actually answers these questions all day.
Bringing the extra bat tonight. If we finish before 8, same corner table after?
Yes, but I am not ordering fries for the whole dugout again.
Fine, just save me a seat where we can see the ninth without that pillar blocking it.
Deal. I will bring my blue cap in case they keep the sound on.
You still at the sports bar or did you escape before everyone ordered another basket?
Escaped, barely. My lunch container is still in the clinic fridge so tomorrow morning is already annoying.
That sounds like a future-you problem. Want me to ask if they have the kitchen open for slices?
Yes, but just one. I am too wiped to make anything when I get home.
If you come by Sunday, remind me to send those old Calhoun County Fair photos with you. Your mom wants the ones by the parts counter too.
The ones with Grandpa's produce table or the ones where you are covered in grease by the yellow baler?
Both. And don't laugh at the CHS jacket. It still fits if I don't zip it.
Mom will definitely make me label the box before I leave.
Your mom said that church supper thing got moved to Saturday. She put it on that Hardin page.
I saw it when I was checking the tab with all the flyers. Same place had a Riverbend Players notice too.
Found that file folder you asked about. It has the Jerseyville hospital paper and your shot record.
Perfect. Does it also have the little DA training completion sheet from the office?
If you go out that way, check the road by the landing. Last rain made it rough.
Will do. I saved the supper one and sent Kayla the Players thing in case Friday stays open.
No, just family papers. Ask your mom where she put the work folder.
Okay. The form wants old paperwork plus that same background section I always have to double-check.
Mom said Sunday is 12:15 this time. Dad has to run over to Uncle Ray's after.
12:15 works. Tell her I'll bring the pie if she hasn't already started one.
She found that old Hardin Hawks hoodie in the cedar closet and says it is yours, not mine.
It is mine. You just stole it every winter after you got taller.
You going by Mom's or staying home tonight?
Home. I already have black beans warming and tortillas out.
Fancy Friday lol
Only because cilantro and lime make the same pan of beans feel less sad. Rice is for tomorrow.
Take the river road slow by the grain elevator. They were watching that corner again today.
I learned my lesson after that stop-sign warning. Full pause now, even when nobody is behind me.
Good. Same folks were at that meeting your mom mentioned. Most of them are decent if you talk plain.
Yeah. I still want to hear why people were upset about the camera rules, just not in the comment pile-on.
You survived calling everybody up last night or did the mic finally win
Barely. I had to swap batteries twice and keep the slips in order while half the room changed their minds.
Worth it at least?
Dave handed me $55 and nachos, so yes, especially after my gas light came on.
Mom said you were helping move those folding tables after lunch. You sure you want the heavy end again?
I am taking the light end. My shoulder already complained after yesterday's trays.
Bring the little bottle from your purse then. Last time you acted tough until dinner.
Already packed Tylenol and water. Also I am not paying another copay unless I actually cannot move.
Softball moved to 6:15 Wednesday. Please tell me the little phone boxes have room for us.
Checking now. I already had FitFusion and two registry videos sitting on Wednesday.
Put us in with a loud alert. You forgot cleats last time because you tried to squeeze everything in.
Done. Added cleats, ankle wrap, and dinner from the freezer under it.
I can listen to that front-end noise after lunch. If it is the same rattle, do not let the shop upsell you twice.
County board thing is at 10 at the courthouse if you still wanted to hear them talk roads.
I do. Last big one was easy for me, but these courthouse names all run together unless I write them down.
Thank you. The last invoice is still making my March sheet ugly, so I am trying to avoid another surprise.
Ask about where the gravel money goes. Don't just trust the mailer.
Bring the receipt. We will see what they already charged for before you book anything.
That's on my list, plus the ambulance clinic question. I circled one name from each side of the sheet so far.
Will do. I picked up a Friday singing slot too, so I am patching the extra stuff instead of touching more from savings.
I can swing by after lunch with the small drill if that towel bar is still loose.
That would help. Kayla and I shoved the laundry baskets in the second room so you can get through the hall.
Tell Kayla I only need ten minutes. If the landlord asks, it was already pulling from the wall.
Got it. We wiped the counter at least, so the place looks less like Tuesday exploded.
Mom said you left your glove in Dad's truck again.
Of course I did. Can you toss it by my place before 5:30?
Only if you promise not to do that dramatic slide thing with the taped-up foot.
Jenna already put me on the list, so I have to show. I will keep the sliding to people with better judgment.
You still coming to lunch or did your money app trap you again
Coming. I was just matching Feb: office was about $2,600 after the usual stuff and the karaoke night added $120.
So fries are on you?
Nope, because RiverBank says I already spent too much on snacks and gas.
Radar looks clean till about 3. If you take the river road, watch the soft shoulder past Kampsville.
Your mom said the folding chairs are still in the shed. Need me to bring the dolly?
Thanks. I am keeping it cheap, just bait and maybe a sandwich if Kayla comes.
Yes please. I can load the smaller boxes after lunch, but those chair racks are awkward.
Check your tire pressure before you leave. Poles are still in my shed if yours are tangled.
I'll swing by after I check the mower belt. Same building as the old pancake breakfasts?
I will swing by for them if the clouds stay west.
Yep, basement entrance by the Sunday school rooms. Mom has me on setup, not cleanup this time.
Your passport photo place in Jerseyville is open till 5 Friday. Need me to check the oil before you drive over?
Yes please. I want the little book handled even if it only gets one stamp at first.
Bring cash for the photo. And don't empty that cert envelope over a picture.
I won't. The beach picture is just keeping me from buying random stuff this week.
Can you grab the extra scorebook before you head to the field tomorrow?
Yep. My glove and the blue bag are already in my trunk from last week.
Good. We may hit after if your ankle is still behaving.
It was fine after FitFusion, so I should be okay unless I trip over myself again.
Did you disappear after practice or are you still in the parking lot?
Still here. Opened IG for two seconds and now I have watched three glove-cleaning reels and a nacho dip thing.
Send the dip. The glove thing can stay between you and your algorithm.
Sent it. Also Snap me if you all move tables before I get there.
Ameren posted. Your half is $63. Do you want me to wait until Friday or send the request now?
Send it now. Friday I am trying to tuck $50 away if the car draft does not eat more than I think.
Got it. Also skip karaoke cover this week if you are trying to leave the card alone.
Yeah, movie at home is better. I want that side account closer to four digits before I get brave again.
Could you look at my car after work? I need it quiet before the Alton class night on the 18th.
Bring it by after supper. What class is that far?
The one with the sensor placement lab. If I get the hours done this year, it opens better clinic options.
Then we will make sure the car behaves. Keep your receipts too.
Could I borrow the folding table from the garage Saturday morning? The county building said they only have chairs.
You off yet, or still closing up?
Almost. Waiting on the last notes to save, then I have to bag the last tray and wipe down op 2.
Table is by the freezer. I can throw it in the truck if you need it hauled.
Want me to listen to that car noise when you get home?
Thanks. I have the big jaw model, floss packs, and the two-minute sand timers, so the table is the last bulky thing.
Yes please. I am there Monday through Friday this week, so I do not want it acting up on the river road.
Set it all by the door Friday night and I will grab it.
Mom said the Facebook thread under the county page is already a mess. Do not go in there with paragraphs lol
I typed three sentences and deleted them. Easier to talk at lunch where nobody is screenshotting.
Fair. Also Dad said you better not roll that same corner again or he is making a stop-sign meme of you.
Rude but deserved. One warning was plenty.
You left the rent envelope on the counter. Want me to drop it with mine after work?
Yes please. I almost made a cash-app post last night then deleted it. I just need to text people directly when I get scrambled.
Practical choice. Send me your half when you can, and we can do one clean budget list after Zumba.
Thank you. I sent $12 to Mrs. Lane's meal train too, so remind me no late-night scrolling with my wallet open.
Zumba at 6:45 still happening or did the clinic swallow you again?
Almost there. We ran 38 minutes late, but Marisol took my last room so I could finish the end-of-day entries clean.
Good. Bring the shoes, leave the chart brain in the car.
I have the little paper card clipped to my bag now, so I am less afraid of skipping a step.
Your mom said you wanted the truck Saturday. Need it for the clinic run?
Maybe. I am checking the health department schedule first, then calling Dr. Lewis's office before I put anything on the calendar.
Alright. If they say Saturday, I'll keep the tank filled.
Did you see that video Uncle Rob shared? Two guys just pointing at each other for 6 minutes lol
I closed it. Send me the county page if it says anything real about jobs at the boat yard or that training grant.
Found the actual page. Less dramatic, more boring.
Boring is fine. I want numbers and dates, not people trying to win the loudest face contest.
Can you cover second tonight? Marcus is stuck at work until 7.
I can, but remind me to wear the brace. The base path is still my enemy.
Deal. I will text you at 5 so you do not talk yourself into the couch.
That is exactly why I said yes out loud.
Softball got moved because of rain. Still want to meet at Riverbend around 8?
Yes. I need food, laughing, and that big chorus before I carry this week home with me.
I'll grab a table near the speaker. You doing the sign-up sheet again or just jumping in?
Both if Tina is short. If she hands me cash again, I am putting it straight toward gas.
Shop just posted the pickup window: Saturday 10-2. Yours is under the wedding-party rack, sage tags.
Perfect. I already paid the balance, so I am only letting myself do the taco stand after practice if we split something.
Deal. I will bring cleats and not tempt you with the loaded nachos.
Appreciated. Between that and the car thing, my fun money is basically spoken for.
Sports bar after practice Thursday? Marcus said the debate clips will be on before the Cubs replay.
After practice Tuesday, are we doing drinks or your couch-and-blanket thing again?
Maybe for one drink. I want to hear the hospital district part, not the shouting part.
Couch sounds cheaper. I saved three trailers and one has a soundtrack I kept replaying at lunch.
You and your notebook. Are you still making columns?
Of course you did. If it has a big chorus, you are taking the loud end of the sofa.
Fair. I will text Kayla so she doesn't plan Zumba recovery snacks over it.
Yes. Payroll taxes, roads, clinic hours, school stuff. The columns are a mess.
So did Friday dinner guy earn a second outing or are we saving you for karaoke chaos?
Second outing maybe. Karaoke still wins this week because Kayla already claimed the couch after Zumba.
Fair. Also Marcus asked if your extra room is still off limits for his cousin for April.
Still off limits. That room is our laundry pile and guest-night emergency zone, not a rotating door.
Ameren posted. Your part is $54.18 this time.
Sending it before work. Did my March payment clear on your end too?
Yep, both March lines are green. I left the kitchen mail stack by your bag so it does not vanish again.
Perfect. Zumba bag is by the door, and I swear I will deal with the mail after clinic.
I can grab something after Zumba if you want.
Skip it for me. I grilled the chicken already and made enough quinoa for two containers.
Good call, rent week.
Yep. Extra chicken is going over rice tomorrow so I don't touch the drive-thru.
Leave the car by the side door Saturday if that tapping sound is still there.
Thanks. I can drop it off after work and grab it before lunch Sunday.
Your mom is making chicken and noodles. Cody better not park behind me again.
I'll warn him. Same driveway rules as when we had two school cars jammed in there.
I put Aunt Linda's cake pickup under the family thread so nobody forgets Friday.
Good, that little red number saved me last time. I also saw the library board shared a matinee list.
Your grandma commented on that one. She wants the funny one, not the sad one.
I saved it. After clinic I will check the comments and see if Kayla wants that or the Players thing.
Mom says bring the scanner Sunday. She found another tote of yellow receipt books from the old supply counter.
Of course she did. Are Dad's hauling tickets in that tote too?
Yep, plus a Polaroid of him fixing that auger thing before dawn. Very fashionable work boots.
Do not send that to the family group until I can see it first.
Mom said you left your glove in my truck. Also your red hoodie is still in there.
I need the glove tomorrow. Keep the hoodie if you want, unless the 7:30 tip is actually on here.
You mean the one you always try to get Murphy's to switch to after everyone watches the late innings?
That is very specific for someone pretending not to know.
Mom says don't forget the Hardin address history part. You always ask what year to put.
I know the town. I just forget if they want where the hospital was or where we actually lived.
Put the river house years like last time. Also she found your diploma copy in the cedar chest.
Tell her thanks. I still need the office training page so the packet looks complete.
Are you still doing the back-room mic thing after the Cubs game tonight?
Just the first half. I told Mark I can sort the list and do the opening round, then I need to bail.
Put me later than Marcus. He keeps picking impossible songs and then acting shocked.
Done. I already printed the first page, so quit adding requests after 7.
Team table at O'Briens after practice? They have the mic set up tonight.
Maybe. If my ankle behaves, I am doing two songs max and no extra fries.
You always say two and then stay for the second round of old country.
Only if someone else starts it. I still need to be up early if the morning stays dry.
You in for the sports bar after practice, or are you babying that ankle again?
I can come for one round. Sliding drills are not getting my full confidence yet.
Fair. I will save you a chair and not let Marcus order mystery shots.
Perfect. One cider, food, and I am driving home by 10.
I paid electric. Your half is $54.18 whenever.
Sent. I kept enough for tacos after the clinic crew thing and still have gas money, so we are good.
Tuesday Zumba, Friday karaoke, Sunday lunch. Please leave one blank square somewhere.
Wednesday is blank unless Dad needs me to pick up that part. I can handle the rest if I stop saying yes at the front desk.
Your mom said you left your blue cooler in the back seat Sunday. Need it before I head past Hardin?
Yes please. I have been trying to bring food to the clinic and I forgot that was even in there.
I can drop it by after work. You got softball tonight?
Practice, then maybe Cubs at the bar if I am not dragging. That is usually when I give up and grab something hot.
I found your old folder with the Cancun hotel printouts from last summer. Want me to bring it Sunday?
Yes. Put it with the cert paperwork if you don't mind. Seeing the numbers together helps me behave.
I can do that. The hiking map one is still tucked in there too.
Keep that one in the back pocket. That is not a this-year pile.
Mom found your old fair ribbon box while looking for tablecloths. There is a tiny green clover pin in it lol
Do not roast me. I had to keep record books and everything.
Also she wants to know if you can run Aunt Linda home after the dinner tonight.
Yeah, I can. Tell her I will come early and help carry the drink coolers too.
Mom asked if your car was in the driveway because she saw Kayla's but not yours.
I'm parked behind the house. Went down by the landing after work for a few minutes.
Classic. Also Mr. Allen told Dad your dome light was on at the clinic lot.
Of course he did. I'll run back before it drains. Tell Mom I am fine.
You left a box of tiny toothpaste tubes on the kitchen chair. Is that going with you or can I move it?
Going with me. Please set it by the door with the posters if you need the chair.
Done. Also your travel brush is on the counter because you used mine again last night.
I rinsed it, sorry. I was packing floss cards and forgot mine was already in the tote.
I can make a tab for March if you want. Rent, Ameren, water, groceries.
Please don't make me live in tabs. I checked both apps and our combined take-home for Feb looks around $5,000 to $5,300.
Fine, app screenshots work. Send your half after the next office hit clears?
Yes. I marked the 20th so I don't forget before Zumba.
I can look at that rattle after lunch. You headed to the office first?
Yes, just a half day. Marlene said I could stay after and run through tray setups if the last patient cancels.
Good. Same place, new things to learn.
That's the plan. I don't need a St. Louis apartment just to prove I'm moving forward.
I found your old transcript folder in the hall cabinet. Want me to bring it Sunday?
Yes please. The advisor wants unofficial copies before she talks through the fall science seats.
I will put it with the lunch stuff. Do you need help sorting the fee dates?
Maybe. I am trying to fit the x-ray packet, fall classes, and rent without leaning on everybody.
The tire shop said two fronts would be $386 with mounting. I told them you would call before they order.
Oof. I can pull some from the side account and maybe put the rest on the Visa if it has to happen.
Do not wait if the tread is that low. I can give you a ride Tuesday if you leave it there.
Thanks. I am going to price one more place first because that would wipe out what I just moved over.
Did your lunch break happen today, or did the morning run long?
I got ten minutes. Two bitewing sets, one nervous kid, and three charts still flashing at me.
Eat something before the afternoon starts. You can fix screens better with food in you.
Trying. If DTX stops freezing, I can get the treatment notes done before the 2:30 room turns over.
Are we still leaving at 6:05? I packed the little towels.
Yes. I have my punch card and dry socks. I just need five minutes after work.
No detour then. You have the field thing tomorrow too, right?
Practice if the lights are fixed. I put the cleats by the door so I don't forget.
Mom said you sounded wound up. Need a meme or a ride to throw your phone in the river?
Meme first. I told Kayla I would stop scrolling at 10 and already failed. Also I forgot to answer Jenna and now I feel rude.
Answer her tomorrow. Sing the dramatic car song, make the tiny list, sleep. That is the Trisha protocol.
Rude but accurate. Send meme, then I am plugging my phone in across the room.
A couple teammates are going to the courthouse steps Friday before karaoke. You coming?
I am probably skipping the steps part. I want to know more, but crowds there make me feel awkward.
No pressure. You can meet us after. I figured you had thoughts after that town meeting.
I do. I just talk better with Kayla or Mom than with everyone filming each other.
Are we still doing groceries after work or did karaoke sneak into tonight too?
Groceries are still there. My phone yelled at me at lunch because I had both written in.
Good. Put rent transfer on there while you're looking, before we both forget Friday.
Added it with the study quiz and chicken thaw note. Friday looks less scary now.
Your mom said you were leaving early. Car start okay?
Started fine. Going in early because Dr. H wants the back counter reset before first patient.
Do it in the same order every time. Saves trouble when folks are rushing you.
That is the plan. Dana drew boxes on my pocket card so I can mark each room before I close it.
Saw your car at Casey's. Please tell me you were not buying dinner from the warmer again.
Rude. Also accurate. I had back-to-back rooms all afternoon and never opened the lunch bag.
So the famous Monday containers survived until Thursday?
One survived. The other one is tomorrow's problem if I remember it before I leave.
Mrs. Allen at church asked about that post going around. I told her you usually check with the office first.
That is what I am doing. Dr. Lewis's nurse called back, and the dental office had the same handout from the county.
Good. Bring me a copy Sunday if you still have it.
I will. It is clearer than the thread everyone keeps forwarding.
You saw Dad's comment under Mom's fish fry post right? He typed the whole thing in caps lol
Yes, and then the same scroll gave me a singing flyer for Grafton, so now my Friday is a mess.
Do the singing one. Send me videos if Kayla actually gets on stage.
Maybe. I saved that and the Rialto preview list, so I need to pick before I promise anybody.
Are you coming to practice after the radiography thing or are you stuck doing packet homework again?
Practice, yes. Packet is mostly done, just the Aug 14 line and those two little background boxes.
Bring it to the bar after and I'll check if you missed any blanks.
Thanks. No student ID section for me, so at least that page is easy.
Sports bar after practice? They have the county forum on the side TV until first pitch.
Maybe. If it turns into everybody booing, I'm moving tables.
Fair. You mostly wanted to hear the hospital shuttle answer anyway, right?
That and whether the training money is for real classes or just a ribbon-cutting photo.
You were quiet for the whole ride. Please tell me you were not shopping again.
No buying. Just TikTok while we waited at the train. That girl fixed clumpy mascara with a clean spoolie and now I need to try it.
Try it after work, not at the stoplight.
Fine. I saved it next to the liner one from last week.
Can you grab paper plates before people come over tonight? I handled the utility bill.
Yes. I sent you my half and I am adding soda, plates, and the cheap candy from Dollar General.
Good. Also please make the playlist before everyone is here because last time you vanished into YouTube for 20 minutes.
Already started it. I need the opening song to hit right when everyone walks in.
Are you coming home between the field and Main Street or should I feed myself?
Feed yourself. Jenna says the back table is open and they will put the Chicago channel on if we ask early.
Budget version of dinner again?
Probably pretzels and one soda. I just want to catch the first few frames with them.
I can bring the drill Saturday for that shelf. Kayla going to be around to hold the other side?
Yes, she is off by noon. It is just us moving things, no extra hands unless Cody gets bored.
Need me to make it stronger in case that fellow from dinner starts leaving boots by the door?
Ha, no. If anyone ever gets a real drawer here, you will get more warning than a shelf project.
Mrs. Dawes said thank you for sitting with her before the x-ray room. She told me you talked about pie crust until she quit shaking.
She was scared of the machine, not me. Apple pie was easier than medical words.
Can you still bring napkins to the church supper tonight, or did softball move?
Practice is at 5:45, supper stuff is in my car, and Jenna said she will save me a plate if I am late.
Rough day?
Very. I am going to walk first, then meet Kayla and let the microphone take the rest of it.
That sounds better than stewing in the apartment. Text me when you get home.
Did Oak Street actually give you the envelope or do I need to glare at someone next time
They did. $50 plus the tip cup had $17 after I split it with Sam.
Good. Put it toward electric before we accidentally treat ourselves to takeout.
Already set aside. Two of those nights this month covered more than I expected.
Are you still going through those flashcards tonight or did Mrs. B's casserole delivery derail you?
She stayed ten minutes and asked if I remembered being terrified to answer phones my first week at Larkin's.
And now you're the one correcting the tray list on the fridge.
I know. Rent is easier with us here, and the packet feels like the next right step instead of running off.
When you stop by, can you read the tiny print on these W-2 copies? They were tucked behind my old Lewis & Clark folder.
Sure. Are these from the place with the seed calendars and the green front door?
That's the one. Your dad's CHS tassel is in the same drawer somehow, along with two grease pencils.
That drawer sounds like our whole family in one pile.
Drive after groceries? I need to clear my head before bills.
Yes. Let's loop past the grain bins and the river, then swing by my parents so I can drop off Mom's container.
Works. Your dad will probably already know we forgot trash bags before we pull in.
He noticed my wiper streaks from across the lot last week, so probably.
Mrs. Hanley said her grandkids are still using the little timers from your booth.
That makes me happy. The dinosaur chart got more attention than my whole poster board.
She also asked where you got those floss cards. I told her I would ask you before Sunday lunch.
I have extras in my car. I can bring a stack, and I still need to schedule my next cleaning before I forget.
I put your certificate folder with the old report cards in the hallway cabinet, bottom shelf.
Perfect, thank you. I can pick it up when I come by Sunday.
Dad can carry the tote to your car. Cody left two boxes in that same cabinet, so check the labels.
Of course he did. I still know which side of that cabinet was his.
Are you doing Riverside tonight or skipping? I am trying to plan dinner.
Going. Jenna will roast me if I leave them short again, and my glove is already by the door.
Take the ice pack this time. Last time you came home limping and then pretended you were fine.
Packed it. If people are waiting on me, I get there; if it is just me, I suddenly become very busy.
I entered rent and Ameren. Your half is the usual, due Friday. Want me to mark it paid when it hits?
Yes please. After Friday I should still land just under $2,000 for March if I keep packing food.
Good. Movie night here then? Cheaper than driving to Alton and we already have popcorn.
Exactly. Last month scared me enough that I am choosing couch plans until the dress and car receipts quit staring at me.
Did the tire place end up charging all of it today?
No, I found used ones for $312. I used the side account and left the card alone, but April is going to be boring.
Boring is fine. If something serious comes up before you build it back, call us first.
I will. I do not want to ask unless I really have to, especially since I am not behind with you guys.
Mom said lunch might be at your place Sunday. Should I bring chairs or a hazmat suit
Bring chairs, smart mouth. Kayla and I are doing the 30-minute tornado clean Saturday after Zumba.
So I should arrive at 12:30 and not 12:00.
Arrive at 12:15 and pretend the laundry mountain never existed.
Do you want me to send leftovers home Sunday?

events.title: CVS stop before practice
events.notes: Grab ibuprofen, ankle wrap, and cheap ice pack. Check portal estimate before adding any extra appointment.

events.title: Aldi run + prep bowls

events.notes: Leave from our place by 5:55. Before leaving: clear sink, take trash out, Venmo K. for power bill.

events.title: FitFusion with Kayla
events.notes: Leave work shoes in the car; bring water bottle and the punch card.

events.title: Envelope check: cert + blue-water folder
events.notes: Move $35 before takeout. Tape the beach printout to the inside cover. Leave the mountain route screenshot in the someday page.

events.title: Update March sheet + transfer from singing cash
events.notes: Last month closed at $2,200 after the dress deposit and the Malibu shop visit. March target: keep regular cards/checking near $1,950; pack lunches Tue/Thu.

events.title: 6-month cleaning before shift
events.notes: Bring insurance card; ask for extra kid-size brush samples for March table.

events.title: Pick up Grandma, then tables and coffee urns
events.notes: Grab the blue tote from Mom's trunk; sign-up sheets, napkins, and two extension cords.

events.title: Shawnee Valley field night
events.notes: Bring cleats, glove, water bottle. Keep the black wrap in the car just in case; Jenna needs final head count by noon.

events.title: Courthouse listening session
events.notes: Sit near the back with Mom. Listen to the camera-policy comments; skip posting afterward.

events.title: Before clinic: rooming cards + note steps
events.notes: Pack badge. Read Dr. H's add-on instructions. Put the paper step card in scrub pocket before 7:30 shift.

events.title: Drop renewal packet at Riverbend office

events.notes: Bring two IDs, two checks, signed 12-month pages. Ask for mailbox label to stay Trisha / Kayla.

events.title: Stop by pharmacy counter
events.notes: Bring county handout printout. Ask whether Dr. Lewis's timing note still matches the March schedule.

events.title: Zumba, shower, phone away by 10
events.notes: Bring water. After class: pay Kayla utilities, pack clinic bag, write Friday list before bed.

events.title: Online info session: chairside x-ray permit + prereq map
events.notes: Ask about bitewing/pano hours, board paperwork, A&P and micro timing, and whether evening labs work with clinic shifts.

events.title: Read county board notes before Zumba

events.title: Payday: move $25

events.title: Office money landed - move bills

events.title: Check Saturday sky + trunk stuff

events.title: Riverbend: song slips + mic check
events.notes: Bring black binder, spare batteries, and the printed rotation sheet. Ask Dave about the envelope before leaving.

events.title: Living room setup with Kayla + Jenna
events.notes: Move coffee table, set out blankets, cue the streaming list, charge speaker, chips on counter.

events.title: Maybe: Riverbend Players + late show shortlist

events.notes: Look at saved tab again after work. Kayla liked the one-act post; also compare the three trailer links Cody dropped under it.

events.title: Riverbend mic rotation - slips, raffle, closing list
events.notes: Bring charger, spare pens, cough drops. Ask Tina about the $45 envelope before leaving.

events.title: Sunday runaround
events.location: Hardin / church hall / Mom and Dad's
events.notes: Drop two pans at church hall by 9:30; check Grandma's ride; lunch at Mom and Dad's 12:15; text Kayla before stopping for groceries.

events.title: Lunch at Mom and Dad's

events.notes: Bring Kayla's borrowed pan back. Take the long way along the Illinois River if roads are clear.

events.title: Sunday lunch + sort Mom's back-room boxes
events.notes: Ask Dad where the wrench manuals are. Mom wants the invoice folders, counter slips, and Lewis & Clark notebook separated from the family photo tubs.

events.title: Shawnee Valley practice + Murphy's after
events.notes: Check score before leaving field; ask if back room TV has Chicago feed.

events.title: Grab lunch bag before clinic
events.notes: Rice bowl on middle shelf. Put fork in side pocket. If Zumba runs late, use freezer flatbread instead of stopping twice.

events.title: Stop by Dr. Larkin's before shift
events.notes: Give Marlene updated availability; ask about extra chairside practice on Fridays; bring radiography forms from kitchen table.

events.title: Scan clinic packet forms before work
events.notes: Need birth page, old diploma copy, DA training sheet, and the section with origin boxes before Kayla leaves.

events.title: Radiography packet: 3 items
events.notes: Check email from program office. Finish module 4 questions. Add April due dates after dinner.

events.title: KC hall night - boots
events.notes: Meet by the side door; check whether Kayla wants to ride along after work.

events.title: Table shift - Calhoun County wellness day
events.notes: Tote: posters, jaw model, timers, floss cards, sticker sheets. Text Dad for pickup after cleanup.

events.title: Pick up sage dress + alterations receipt
events.notes: Put receipt in March folder. No coffee stop on the way back; groceries at home.

events.title: Try saved chicken pasta

events.title: Mom's chicken & noodles
events.notes: Ask Mom about the insurance form; bring Cody's hoodie from the back seat.

events.title: Landlord walkthrough window

events.title: Riverside Park lineup slot
events.notes: Arrive early for warmup throws. Pack ankle sleeve, extra socks, and the blue bat bag. Text Jenna if running more than 10 minutes late.

events.title: Bitewing/pano positioning lab

events.notes: Bring scrub top, badge, $85 check, printed employer hours form, and questions about clinic coordinator pathway.

events.title: Pack clinic lunches

events.title: Check polling place + finish local race notes

events.title: Benefits portal + desk stretches
events.notes: Look up visit estimate during lunch. Do the printout from last year's ankle packet and shoulder band set before evening shift.

events.title: Office money landed - send Kayla

events.title: Payday check-in

events.title: Passport forms + Cancun fare watch

events.title: Oak Street list table

events.title: Grafton if clear

events.title: Service, lunch, pantry boxes

events.title: Lunch reset: call Mom, then close AM rooms

events.title: Call county office + save note from pharmacist

events.title: Reset night

events.title: After Zumba: pack clinic lunch

events.title: Drop off copies at clinic office
events.notes: Include Jerseyville page, Hardin address list, diploma copy, chairside-hours note, and completed background boxes.

events.title: Radiography study block
events.notes: Review bitewing positioning pages; text Marlene two questions before Monday; thank Mrs. B Sunday if she is at lunch.

events.title: Coffee with Nolan, then movie night at home
events.notes: Keep it early. Kayla has popcorn; Venmo her utilities half before movie.

events.title: Friday couch plan
events.notes: Pick final stream by 7:00, popcorn at 7:10, Bluetooth speaker by window, leave room for Cody if he drops by.

events.title: Team table at Murphy's
events.notes: Wear blue cap; ask about Wrigley sound first. If local feed cuts over, stay for red-and-black fourth quarter.

events.title: Set up books + last-hour mic list
events.notes: Eat first. Keep water at booth. Tina said payout depends on crowd, usually $35-$50.

events.title: Drop archive envelope at historical society
events.notes: Envelope: Grandpa stand photos, Dad's repair-route cards, Mom's counter ledgers, CHS program, and Lewis & Clark class schedule.
